lines.text: He ghosted our group chat last week.

data.define: To end contact with a person without any explanation.

example.text: He ghosted our group chat last week.

misuse.text: Don't say 'ghosted' about a friend who's sick.

publish.title: What does "ghost" mean?
publish.value: Ghost = Suddenly stop replying to someone. Example: "He ghosted our group chat last week." (very casual English, US).
